author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a potty chair with a round-topped backrest and seat at the left, a child with a large ring head sitting on its front edge with knees up and a hand on the knee; reads as a child on a potty. A curved-torso first candidate left an undersized hole between torso, arm and thigh; the straight torso and wider knee fixed it. The rejected drawing had a box potty and a disconnected figure.
omissions: The arch cutout in the potty base is dropped (base must stay 8 below the seat); the child's second arm and leg are omitted as in a side view.
drawing_plan: SQUARE; potty x 6..26: backrest 6..14 with r4 top at y 20..24, seat y 34, base y 42; head r5 at (30,11); neck (30,24); torso to hip (26,34); thigh to knee (42,28); shin to (42,42); arm neck to knee.
